item.title: Lisa Knowles-Smith, Darrel Walls & More Win Big at 2026 Stellar Gospel Music Awards: Full Winners List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we're celebrating the best in gospel music. The 2026 Stellar Gospel Music Awards just took place at the Spectrum Center in Charlotte, North Carolina, and we've got the scoop on the big winners.
[Upbeat music transitions]
Host: This year's ceremony was hosted by the one and only Kirk Franklin, and it was an exciting night with many talented artists taking home awards. Lisa Knowles-Smith and Darrel Walls were the big winners of the evening. Lisa Knowles-Smith, a 42-year-old gospel superstar, won an impressive five awards, including the Albertina Walker female artist of the year award. She also took home awards for duo/chorus/group of the year and quartet of the year alongside The Brown Singers, as well as producer of the year and song of the year for "Promises (Live)".
[Music transitions to a softer tone]
Host: Darrel Walls, 35, won two awards: artist of the year and contemporary male artist of the year, both for his album "Heart of Mine". Other notable winners include Vincent Bohanan & SOV, who took home three awards, and Jonathan McReynolds, John P. Kee, Jekalyn Carr, and The Brown Singers, who each won two awards.
[Music transitions back to an upbeat tone]
Host: The show also honored some legends in the industry, with Tasha Cobbs Leonard receiving the Aretha Franklin Icon Award and Pastor Mike Jr. receiving the Thomas A. Dorsey Most Notable Achievement Award.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: If you missed the ceremony, don't worry! The 41st Stellar Gospel Music Awards will premiere on The Stellar Network on August 29th, and then make its national cable premiere on BET on August 30th. It will also air on other networks and stations throughout the month of September. Congratulations to all the winners, and thank you for tuning in to our podcast! [Outro music continues to play until the end]
